title: Capture complete uniform-grid geometry
description: Define and expose sheet-layout inputs for rectangular sheets with uniform square or rounded-rectangle labels, including every dimension and the four-state corner-radius disclosure.
acceptanceCriteria: Inputs include sheet width and height, row and column counts, label width and height, four independent margins, and horizontal and vertical gaps
Corner radius is represented as `zero`, `known`, `estimated`, or `unknown` rather than a nullable number
Each dimensional input carries an explicit unit and retains its source text until validation
Rows and columns accept only bounded positive integers
Unsupported non-uniform or non-rectangular media cannot be represented as valid input

steps.details: Create serializable source-input types for every PRD field and a discriminated corner-radius state whose known and estimated variants carry a source dimension.
Create a separate millimetre-based validated geometry value for sheet, grid, labels, margins, gaps, and radius disclosure; prevent unvalidated source strings from satisfying it.
Render labeled controls for all dimensions, counts, independent margins, gaps, radius state, and radius value when applicable, with units exposed in text.
Add schema checks for required fields, bounded integer counts, and corner-radius variant payloads while preserving invalid source text for correction.
Exercise every input and radius state by accessible name and confirm unsupported media choices are absent or explicitly refused.

technicalNotes: Use millimetres only for normalized domain geometry; source fields retain user-entered units.
Unknown radius is semantically different from zero radius.
